meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后,当你想检查 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的安装是否正常时,Claude 会对比你电脑上的安装和最新源码,逐项检查版本、配置、插件连接等,给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告和修复建议,期间不会改动你的安装。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我诊断”或“做个健康检查”,提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或感觉 Codex 在安装/更新后有点不对劲时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装是否正常。
我更新了 Codex 之后它好像有问题,帮我看看。
say.note: Claude 会诊断安装健康并给出修复建议。

say.text: 对比一下我本地的 LazyCodex 和最新版有什么差异。
say.note: Claude 会列出漂移项和已知问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude diagnoses LazyCodex/Codex install health against the latest sources, checks versions, config, plugin wiring, and runtime, and outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence and remediation suggestions, without altering the user's setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a health check, mentions LazyCodex/Codex keywords, or reports odd behavior after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex and Codex installations are healthy.
say_en.note: Claude will run checks and report PASS/WARN/FAIL.

say_en.text: I updated Codex and now it seems broken—please diagnose.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect install health and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest version and list differences.
say_en.note: Claude will report drift and known issues.
